data.body_html:
Imagine gliding across the Mediterranean as the sun sinks behind La Concha, a glass of cava in hand, with the one you love. That's the promise of a Cabopino boat rental sunset romantic dinner cruise from Puerto Banús. Starting at just 749€ for 2 hours, you get a private boat, a licensed skipper, drinks, and snacks — plus the most spectacular sunset on the Costa del Sol. No hidden fees, no crowds, just you, the sea, and the golden hour.

Why Choose a Sunset Dinner Cruise from Cabopino?

Cabopino is one of Marbella's most charming coastal spots, with its dune-backed beach and laid-back chiringuitos. But for a truly romantic evening, nothing beats watching the sunset from the water. Our sunset cruises depart from nearby Puerto Banús, just 10 minutes away by car. You'll sail past the Golden Mile, spot the silhouette of La Concha, and anchor in a quiet cove like Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés. The sea is calm, the light is soft, and the experience is pure magic.

Our Fleet for Romantic Sunset Cruises

For an intimate evening, we recommend our Tier A boats. The Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 passengers) and Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 passengers) are both stylish, well-maintained, and perfect for couples. Each has a spacious flybridge where you can lounge and take in the views, plus a saloon and forward sunbeds. Both depart from Puerto Banús and include a skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks. For a larger group, consider the Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 passengers) — pricing on request.

What's Included in Your Cabopino Sunset Cruise

  • Licensed English-speaking skipper
  • Fuel for the full duration
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava
  • Light snacks (olives, crisps, nuts)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%) — no surprises

You're welcome to bring your own dinner or champagne. Many couples arrange a private catered meal — just ask us via WhatsApp.

Best Time for a Romantic Sunset Cruise

Sunset times vary by season. In summer (June–August), sunset is around 21:30–21:45, so a 2-hour cruise departing at 20:30 is ideal. In spring and autumn, sunset is earlier — aim for 19:00–20:00. We recommend booking at least a week in advance, especially for weekends and holidays. The sea temperature in summer is a pleasant 24–26°C, perfect for a dip before dinner.

How to Book Your Cabopino Sunset Dinner Cruise

Booking is simple. Visit our homepage or send us a WhatsApp message. We'll confirm availability, take a deposit, and send you all the details. On the day, you'll meet your skipper at Puerto Banús Marina. From there, it's a short sail to Cabopino's coastline. For a romantic proposal or anniversary, let us know — we can arrange flowers, balloons, or a photographer.
